notes.title: Nofsky Zombies comes to Steam!
notes.notes: Nofsky Industries is proud to present Nofsky Zombies! This project has been in development behind the scenes for months! I am so happy to be at a point where it can be published to Steam! This is only the beginning as gameplay overhauls are coming for practically everything. My immediate plans for the future of NZ are to incorporate as many 3d printed assets as I can, and to polish up what I already have before adding additional features. I will make regular posts like this to keep everyone updated on progress and ETA! The future of NZ is bright! Im beyond glad to share the experience with all of you :) ~IPS
